_comment: Candidate policy only. The adult photo helper must stay hidden until release_ready and recognition_enabled are both true after browser, tablet and new held-out validation.

enabled_class_rule.evidence_scope: Previously observed q4 calibration, ABO and Open Images v1 reports only.
enabled_class_rule.rule: A class needs at least one accepted-correct example in each of two distinct earlier datasets and zero accepted-wrong examples.
enabled_class_rule.failure_policy: A fresh held-out failure keeps the whole helper disabled; it does not tune this frozen list.

validation_reason: The quantized candidate is more accurate in local tests, but it still needs a new untouched benchmark and real browser/tablet checks.

runtime.load_policy: Load only after the person chooses a photo and only when recognition is enabled.

acceptance.rule: Show a suggestion only when the best appliance beats the best OOD prompt and the second appliance by the frozen minimum margins.
acceptance.score_notice: Cosine similarities and margins are not user-facing confidence percentages.

local_evidence.quantized_calibration: 50/82 accepted and correct; 0/48 visually audited true-OOD accepted.
local_evidence.abo_external: 16/26 accepted and correct; 0/28 audited OOD accepted.
local_evidence.open_images_external: 5/7 accepted and correct; 0/19 audited OOD accepted.
blockers: The frozen rule needs a new untouched test because earlier external outputs have now been observed.
Steam cleaner has no accepted calibration example under the browser rule.
Node execution does not prove browser or tablet memory, speed or compatibility.
The current OOD sample is too small to establish a low population false-accept rate.
